name: soteria
description: Evidence-aware AI regulatory compliance intake, autofill, applicability triage, and launch planning.

interface.shortDescription: Assess AI products against evidence and regulatory scope.
interface.longDescription: Soteria turns product specifications, links, responsible-AI standards, and evidence references into editable facts, an autofill confidence score, candidate frameworks, blockers, and an owned compliance plan.
interface.defaultPrompt: Assess this AI product with Soteria. Extract editable facts, show autofill confidence, identify candidate frameworks and evidence gaps, then give me a stage-specific plan.
